summary: AXIA Energia filed a Form 6-K disclosing a related-party transaction involving the assignment of rights to use optical ground wire cables and transmission infrastructure to its wholly-owned subsidiary Eletronet for telecommunications services. The agreement totals BRL 125,099,251.20 over 20 years, complying with ANEEL regulations. No price per share, premium, or change of control is present. The filing is a routine disclosure of an operational infrastructure-sharing contract, not a special situation.
